title: Nourishing Juicy Korean Green Pepper Gimbap
description: A pungent and cozy Korean dish from the Gangwon region, featuring green peppers in a low-sodium gimbap, served in a lacquerware bowl.
instructions: Prepare the lacquerware bowl by gently washing it with warm water and letting it dry.
Cut the green peppers into thin strips and set them aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, salt, and black pepper to create the emulsified sauce.
Add the cooked korean rice to the bowl with the emulsified sauce and mix well.
Lay a dried seaweed sheet flat on a cutting board.
Spread a thin layer of the rice mixture onto the seaweed sheet, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Arrange the green pepper strips, spinach leaves, and grated carrots horizontally across the middle of the rice.
Roll the gimbap tightly using a bamboo sushi mat or a clean tea towel.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients to make more gimbap rolls.
Slice the gimbap into 1-inch thick rounds and serve in the lacquerware bowl.
